## PRE-FLIGHT (execute ALL in parallel before reading anything)

```bash
git log --oneline -7                        # recent history + commit style
git status --short                          # uncommitted changes
git diff HEAD --stat                        # change scope
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20           # TypeScript strict check
docker ps --filter "name=mcorch" --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"
docker ps --filter "name=mega-brain" --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"
curl -s http://localhost:8001/api/v2/heartbeat  # Chroma API v2 health
ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null                    # BoK suites disponíveis
wc -l HANDOFF.md                            # total lines — drives the read-from-end offset
```

Read in parallel (HANDOFF.md uses **read-from-end strategy** — SSP-01 v6.5.0; monolítico newest-first, **~10k+ linhas e crescendo** — rode o `wc -l` do pre-flight, NÃO assuma um total fixo):
- `HANDOFF.md` with `limit=30` → FIRST ACTION FOR NEXT AGENT + o topo do Task State (a 1ª linha do Task State = a fase mais recém-selada; é o que importa).
- ⚠️ **TOKEN-CAP GUARD (aprendido 2026-07-19):** as linhas do Task State e dos Records são **parágrafos densos (2-4k chars cada)** — uma janela de 55-400 linhas pode **estourar o teto de 25k tokens do Read** e falhar. **Regra:** leia em janelas de **≤150 linhas**; se o Read retornar erro de token-cap, **corte a janela pela metade** e repita. Nunca insista numa janela grande "porque o doc manda".
- Para o Record mais recente (últimas 1-2 fases seladas): comece em `offset ≈ (total − 40)` com `limit=20` (pega a última linha do Task State) e depois leia o bloco `## … Record` mais novo em janelas ≤150 linhas subindo. As seções de sufixo (Pending Actions · GraphRAG State · Infrastructure · Key Files) ficam **no `CLAUDE.md`/`sprint-priorities`**, não no fim do HANDOFF.md — priorize aquelas.
- 📌 **Se `wc -l HANDOFF.md` > ~4000:** o arquivo está pesado demais p/ pickup eficiente — sinalize nos ALERTAS que o `/handoff` deveria **arquivar Records antigos** (ver Phase 5 do seal). Um HANDOFF.md enxuto (Task State + ~12 Records recentes) é o alvo.
- `CLAUDE.md` (architecture rules, data flow, key files — incluindo MCORCH Master Execution Protocol + Survival Laws link)
- `.claude/context/sprint-priorities.md` (sprint goal, 4Cs snapshot, top gaps)
- `/home/ubuntu/.claude/projects/-home-gcrUX-htdocs-constellation-orchestra/memory/MEMORY.md` (memory index)

> ⚠️ **Auditoria histórica de seals antigos:** usar `Read` com offset arbitrário em HANDOFF.md (fora do fluxo padrão de pickup). Ordering newest-first: seal mais antigo ≈ linha 2805, seal mais recente logo após linha 71. Cada `## <Phase> Record (YYYY-MM-DD)` marca um seal. Manter o Read em chunks ≤ 400 linhas para preservar budget de tokens.

Also check for loose files in scratch/:
```bash
ls scratch/ 2>/dev/null && echo "⚠️ scratch/ has files — consider moving to .claude/scripts/db/" || echo "scratch/ clean ✅"
```

### BoK Gate check (v3 — MCORCH Master Execution Protocol)

For each BoK suite in `docs/bok/<slug>/`, verify completeness:
```bash
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  if [ "$slug" = "security" ]; then
    required_sec=(00-deepsearch-blueprint 01-brd-security 02-srs-secure-spec 03-sdd-hardening-architecture 04-fmea-security)
    missing=()
    for doc in "${required_sec[@]}"; do
      [ -f "docs/bok/security/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
    done
    [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ security — BoK complete (ciso-4-artifact)" || echo "⚠️ security — missing: ${missing[*]}"
    continue
  fi
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete" || echo "⚠️ $slug — missing: ${missing[*]}"
done
```

If the user mentions working on a **new module / complex feature / integration / architectural change**:
- Check whether `docs/bok/<expected-slug>/` exists with all 9 docs.
- If missing: surface in the **ALERTAS** section as a critical block per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.
- Recommend `/bok-scribe <idea summary>` before any code is written.

## Fase 7 (opcional) — PMO handoff (`pmo-curator`)

Depois de entregar o brief, **ofereça** disparar o PMO tático: a skill `pmo-curator` lê o mesmo estado, aplica MAPE-K de PROGRESSO e materializa os próximos passos priorizados em `NEXT-STEPS.md` (un-gated vs gated, dependências, deadlines, comando exato de cada passo executável).

- **Quando oferecer:** sempre que o Sovereign, após o brief, pedir "os próximos passos / o que atacar primeiro / priorize o backlog / gere o plano".
- **Como:** invocar a skill `pmo-curator` (ou delegar ao subagente homônimo). Ela é **plan-only** — não executa nada.
- **Fronteira:** o `pmo-curator` é o loop de PROGRESSO; **não** é o guardião MAPE-K (loop de confiabilidade — infra/incidentes). SOP: `docs/processes/pmo-curator.md`.

Não force — o `/handson` continua entregando o brief como sempre; o PMO é uma camada de planejamento opcional por cima.

---

## Rules

- **TypeScript errors → report immediately.** If there are TS errors, list them under ALERTAS. Do not start implementing new features until errors are resolved (unless the user explicitly asks to proceed despite errors).
- **Unhealthy containers → report with triage.** Suggest the fix command if known (e.g., `docker compose restart mcorch-vector-engine` for chroma).
- **Uncommitted changes → describe, do not commit.** Only describe what exists in the working tree; committing is the user's call.
- **Keep the brief tight.** No padding. No repetition of CLAUDE.md architecture. The user already knows the architecture — they need the delta: what changed, what's broken, what's next.
- **Pending Actions priority order:** CRITICAL (before first client) > NON-CRITICAL > Phase Zeta > Core v3 > Epsilon v9.
- **Knowledge Mesh numbers:** use `GraphRAG State` section from HANDOFF.md as the source. Do not invent counts.

> 139	function readChunk(fd: number, start: number, len: number): Buffer {

> 141	  let read = 0;
> 142	  while (read < len) {
> 143	    const n = readSync(fd, buf, read, len - read, start + read);
> 144	    if (n <= 0) break;
> 145	    read += n;
> 146	  }
> 147	  return read === len ? buf : buf.subarray(0, read);
> 148	}

> 289	/** Build the videos.insert metadata body from the job's snippet/status/localizations (private by default). */
> 290	function buildMeta(job: Any): { meta: Json; parts: string; notify: boolean } {

> 292	  const st = (job.status_opts ?? {}) as Any;
> 293	  const snippet: Json = {

> 295	    description: String(s.description ?? '').slice(0, 5000),
> 296	    tags: Array.isArray(s.tags) ? s.tags.slice(0, 50) : undefined,
> 297	    categoryId: s.categoryId ? String(s.categoryId) : '22',
> 298	    defaultLanguage: s.defaultLanguage || undefined,
> 299	    defaultAudioLanguage: s.defaultAudioLanguage || undefined,
> 300	  };
> 301	  const status: Json = {

> 303	    selfDeclaredMadeForKids: st.selfDeclaredMadeForKids === true,
> 304	    license: st.license === 'creativeCommon' ? 'creativeCommon' : 'youtube',
> 305	    embeddable: st.embeddable !== false,
> 306	  };
> 307	  // publishAt requires privacyStatus=private (YouTube schedules private→public at that time).
> 308	  if (st.publishAt) { status.privacyStatus = 'private'; status.publishAt = st.publishAt; }

> 312	  if (job.localizations && typeof job.localizations === 'object' && Object.keys(job.localizations).length) {
> 313	    meta.localizations = job.localizations;
> 314	    parts += ',localizations';
> 315	  }
> 316	  return { meta, parts, notify: st.notifySubscribers === true };
> 317	}

> 349	    // Mesh observation (Mesh Mandate) — best-effort; the embed trigger fires on insert.

> 355	      metadata: { kind: 'youtube_upload', job_id: jobId, video_id: videoId, warnings },
> 356	    }).select('id').maybeSingle();
> 357	    nodeId = node?.id ?? null;
> 358	
> 359	    await supabase.rpc('finalize_youtube_upload', {

> 361	      p_warnings: warnings, p_node_id: nodeId,

> 375	}

> 377	/** One drain pass: reap dead 'running', then claim + process every queued upload. */
> 378	async function drainOnce(): Promise<number> {
> 379	  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - RUNNING_TIMEOUT_MS).toISOString();
> 380	  await supabase.from('youtube_uploads')
> 381	    .update({ state: 'queued' }).eq('state', 'running').lt('updated_at', cutoff)
> 382	    .then(() => {}, () => {});
> 383	
> 384	  const { data: queued, error } = await supabase
> 385	    .from('youtube_uploads').select('id').eq('state', 'queued')
> 386	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true }).limit(5);
> 387	  if (error || !queued?.length) return 0;
> 388	
> 389	  let n = 0;
> 390	  for (const q of queued) {
> 391	    const { data: claim } = await supabase.rpc('begin_youtube_upload', { p_job_id: q.id });
> 392	    if (!claim || (claim as Any).claimed !== true) continue; // already claimed by another worker
> 393	    await processJob((claim as Any).job);
> 394	    n++;
> 395	  }
> 396	  return n;
> 397	}
> 398	
> 399	async function main() {
> 400	  if (process.argv.includes('--once')) {
> 401	    const n = await drainOnce();
> 402	    console.log(`drained ${n} upload(s)`);
> 403	    process.exit(0);
> 404	  }

> 406	  await logHealth('healthy', 'worker_started');

> 412	    }

> 414	  }
> 415	}

O negócio deste módulo não é "mais um inbox" — é o inbox **nativo do flywheel gerar→publicar→conversar→converter→medir** que o MCORCH já possui (MR-CRM-007), com economia per-tenant BYOK + mcoCoins por uso contra o pricing flat dos SaaS rivais (MR-CRM-006) e compliance nativo como barreira de entrada (MR-CRM-008).

> 24	3. **Escopo MVP por diretiva Sovereign 2026-07-18:** Fatias 1+2 do blueprint **juntas, WhatsApp-first** — inbox operável de ponta a ponta para o Usuário Zero (BR-CRM-010). > 8	## 1. Executive Summary
> 9	
> 10	O `crm-suite` transforma o MCORCH de **motor de conteúdo** em **motor de receita**: a distribuição já produz atenção;
> 11	o CRM converte atenção em relacionamento mensurável e relacionamento em negócio fechado. A tese econômica não é
> 12	"vender um CRM" — é **reter no ecossistema o valor que hoje escoa no fim do funil**, e fazê-lo com custo marginal
> 13	de IA igual a zero na fundação.
> 14	
> 15	**Postura de custo (decisiva):** a spine inteira custa **0 mcoCoins**. Não há chamada de LLM, não há provider externo,
> 16	não há `deduct_mco_coins` em nenhum caminho do CRM Suite hoje. Isso é uma escolha, não uma omissão: a fundação tem que
> 17	ser gratuita para ser usada sem fricção, e a monetização entra só nos pilares que consomem IA de verdade
> 18	(pontuação, intenção do comprador, agente de ticket). Marcar custo onde não há consumo seria fabricar economia.

> 27	| **BO-2** | O operador enxerga o pipeline de receita sem planilha externa | `deals` abertos com `amount` e `stage` válidos | ≥90% | Fase 2 | ✅ superfície viva (`/dashboard/deals`) |
> 28	| **BO-3** | Todo canal de captura entra pelo caminho único auditável | canais chamando `crm_capture_lead` ÷ canais ativos | 100% | Fase 1-2 | ⚠️ 1 de ~4 |
> 29	| **BO-4** | Custo de IA da fundação permanece zero | mcoCoins debitados por operação de CRM da spine | **0** | permanente | ✅ verificado (zero `deduct_mco_coins` no módulo) |

> 72	## 5. ROI Model
> 73	
> 74	**Custos (materiais, verificados):**
> 75	
> 76	| Item | Custo |
> 77	|---|---|
> 78	| Infra adicional | **R$ 0** — 6 tabelas + 1 RPC no Postgres existente; nenhum container, nenhum serviço novo |
> 79	| Custo de IA por operação | **US$ 0** — zero chamadas de LLM na spine |
> 80	| Licença | **R$ 0** — código soberano; caminho AGPL descartado justamente para não pagar em contaminação |
> 81	| Edge functions novas | 1 (`submit-lead-webhook`) — dentro do cap de 100 fns (deploy single, não bulk) |
> 82	| Custo humano | Tempo de engenharia por fatia (o custo real e dominante) |
> 83	
> 84	**Fluxos de receita (indiretos — o CRM não vende, ele evita perder):**
> 85	
> 86	1. **Lead retido** — cada lead que hoje se perderia por falta de destino é receita potencial preservada.
> 87	2. **Ciclo mais curto** — funil visível reduz negócio esquecido em estágio morto.
> 88	3. **Retenção de plataforma** — um tenant com CRM povoado não migra; o dado de relacionamento é o maior custo de saída que existe.
> 89	4. **Upsell futuro** — pilares com IA (pontuação avançada, intenção do comprador, agente de ticket) são os que carregam mcoCoins.
> 90	
> 91	**Payback:** imediato em termos de caixa (custo marginal ~zero); o investimento é tempo de engenharia.
> 92	**Modelo de payback quantificado — NÃO VERIFICADO:** não há volume de leads/ticket médio/taxa de conversão medidos
> 93	para este tenant. Projetar números seria fabricação (Lei 1). Revisitar após o primeiro trimestre de uso real com
> 94	dados de `deals` e `lead_events`.
> 95	
> 96	---
> 97	
> 98	## 6. mcoCoins Economics
> 99	
> 100	| Operação | Custo | Justificativa |
> 101	|---|:--:|---|
> 102	| CRUD de company/deal/pipeline/stage/form | **0** | Escrita direta em tabela sob RLS; sem provider externo |
> 103	| `crm_capture_lead` (qualquer canal) | **0** | RPC determinística; **cobrar captura seria taxar o próprio funil de receita** — antipadrão econômico |
> 104	| Timeline (`crm_activities`) | **0** | Registro local |
> 105	| `lead-score` (marketing-hub, adjacente) | **1 mco** | Já existente e já cobrado — pertence à suíte `marketing-hub`, citado aqui só para não parecer omitido |
> 106	| `campaign-run` (marketing-hub, adjacente) | **10 + 10×N** | Idem |
> 107	| **Pilares com IA (propostos)**: pontuação avançada, intenção do comprador, agente de ticket, e-mail com LLM | **a calibrar** | Obrigatoriamente pelo modelo 4×-floor (`docs/processes/mcoin-cost-calibration.md`: `mco = ceil(usd/0.018 × 4)`). **Não fixar preço aqui sem custo USD medido** |
> 108	
> 109	**Regra travada:** se um pilar futuro do CRM consumir provider pago, a dedução é **atômica via `deduct_mco_coins`**,
> 110	nunca client-side, com refund crédito-positivo no caminho de falha (molde `finalize_vision_job`).
> 111	
> 112	---
> 113	
> 114	## 7. Constraints & Assumptions
> 115	
> 116	**Restrições (duras):**
> 117	
> 118	- **C1** — Reusar, não quebrar: `leads`, `lead_events`, `conversations`/`messages`, `campaigns`, `marketing_consents`
> 119	  já estão em produção com dados. Toda migration é **aditiva** (`ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`).
> 120	- **C2** — Harness Engineering: lógica em hooks; páginas display-only. Verificado nas 4 páginas vivas.
> 121	- **C3** — `/security-review` obrigatório em toda migration (FMEA-011).
> 122	- **C4** — Custom properties enxutas: um `jsonb properties` por objeto no MVP; **sem EAV prematuro**
> 123	  (`companies.properties`, `deals.properties` — `20260719140000:19, 106`). Schema formal de propriedades = fatia futura.
> 124	- **C5** — Cap de 100 edge functions no projeto Supabase: deploy **single** (`npx supabase functions deploy <fn>`),
> 125	  nunca bulk (bulk retorna 402).
> 126	- **C6** — `submit-lead-webhook` é superfície anônima (`verify_jwt = false`): nenhuma informação de outro tenant pode
> 127	  ser derivável dela, e o GET só devolve a definição pública do form.
> 128	
> 129	**Premissas (assumidas, com risco declarado):**
> 130	
> 131	- **A1** — **Contato ≡ `leads`.** O blueprint assume a conflação como caminho não-quebrante e **sinaliza a decisão ao
> 132	  Sovereign** (`00-spine-blueprint.md:22, 79`). Se o Sovereign optar por Contato como objeto separado (estilo HubSpot
> 133	  lead-object), é re-modelagem maior → **OTD-CS-001, ainda em aberto**.
> 134	- **A2** — Tarefas/Chamadas/Reuniões/Compromissos são **views/filtros** sobre `crm_activities` por `activity_type`,
> 135	  não tabelas próprias (`00-spine-blueprint.md:58`). Assume-se que os campos genéricos
> 136	  (`title/body/due_at/completed_at/owner_id/metadata`) bastam. Se um pilar exigir colunas próprias
> 137	  (ex.: gravação de chamada, link de reunião), reabrir → **OTD-CS-002**.
> 138	- **A3** — Single-tenant single-owner é aceitável enquanto o alvo for o Usuário Zero (S1).
> 139	- **A4** — `jsonb properties` cobre a customização até que o volume de campos justifique schema formal.
> 140

> 145	| ID | Risco | Prob. | Impacto | Mitigação |

> 147	| **RB-1** | **Vazamento cross-tenant** de PII de relacionamento | Baixa | **Catastrófico** (LGPD + confiança) | RLS default-deny + FK compostas + trigger guards já em produção; `/security-review` por migration; **falta o smoke automatizado — OTD-CS-004** |

> 149	| **RB-3** | **Tabelas órfãs** — `crm_associations` viva e sem consumidor; `crm_activities` com um só escritor. Capacidade paga e não colhida; pior, o leitor futuro presume que funciona | **Alta (é o estado atual)** | Médio | Documentado explicitamente aqui e no `06-data-model.md`; fatia de timeline/associações priorizada na Fase 1 |
> 150	| **RB-4** | **Erasure incompleta** — pedido LGPD apaga o lead e deixa negócios, atividades e associações com PII | Média | Alto (não-conformidade) | **OTD-CS-005** — estender `erase_lead()` antes de qualquer tenant além do Zero |

sem crontab externo, sem .env, sem curl\n\n-- 1) Fun\u00e7\u00e3o wrapper que chama a edge function E registra telemetria em infra_health_logs\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cron.auto_publish_tick()\nRETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  resp jsonb;\n  http_code int;\n  health text;\n  sb_key text;\nBEGIN\n  -- Busca a service role key do vault\n  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO sb_key\n  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets\n  WHERE name = 'sb_secret_key'\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF sb_key IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sb_secret_key not found in vault';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Chama a edge function auto-publish\n  SELECT net.http_post(\n    url := 'https://bcyvddsykvehvpwstlfa.supabase.co/functions/v1/auto-publish',\n    headers := jsonb_build_object(\n      'Content-Type', 'application/json',\n      'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || sb_key\n    ),\n    body := '{}'::jsonb\n  ) INTO resp;\n\n  -- Extrai HTTP status code (net.http_post retorna jsonb com status_code)\n  http_code := COALESCE((resp->>'status_code')::int, 0);\n  health := CASE WHEN http_code = 200 THEN 'healthy' ELSE 'error' END;\n\n  -- Registra telemetria em infra_health_logs (service='auto-publish-cron' para compatibilidade)\n  INSERT INTO infra_health_logs (service, status, event, metadata)\n  VALUES ('auto-publish-cron', health, 'cron_tick', jsonb_build_object('http', http_code));\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- 2) Agenda a fun\u00e7\u00e3o no pg_cron (a cada 5 min, espelha host cron */5)\nSELECT cron.schedule(\n  job_name => 'auto-publish',\n  schedule => '*/5 * * * *',\n  command => 'SELECT cron.auto_publish_tick();'\n);\n\n-- Rollback:\n-- SELECT cron.unschedule('auto-publish');\n-- DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS cron.auto_publish_tick();"

> 86	    private: 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10',
> 87	  };
> 88	  return map[status ?? ''] ?? 'border-zinc-500/40 text-zinc-300 bg-zinc-500/10';
> 89	}

> 91	// ── Metrics card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 92	function ChannelMetrics() {
> 93	  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeChannelMetrics();
> 94	
> 95	  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
> 96	    if (!data?.columnHeaders?.length || !data.rows?.length) return null;
> 97	    const row = data.rows[0];
> 98	    return Object.fromEntries(
> 99	      data.columnHeaders.map((h, i) => [h.name, row[i]]),
> 100	    ) as Record<string, string | number>;
> 101	  }, [data]);
> 102	
> 103	  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full rounded-xl" />;
> 104	  if (isError) {
> 105	    return (
> 106	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 107	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 108	          Métricas indisponíveis: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 109	        </CardContent>
> 110	      </Card>
> 111	    );
> 112	  }
> 113	  if (!metrics) return null;
> 114	
> 115	  const gained = Number(metrics.subscribersGained ?? 0) - Number(metrics.subscribersLost ?? 0);
> 116	  const tiles = [
> 117	    { label: 'Views (28d)', value: formatNumber(metrics.views), icon: Eye },
> 118	    { label: 'Min. assistidos', value: formatNumber(metrics.estimatedMinutesWatched), icon: Clock },
> 119	    { label: 'Duração média', value: formatSeconds(metrics.averageViewDuration), icon: Clock },
> 120	    { label: '% médio assistido', value: metrics.averageViewPercentage != null ? `${Number(metrics.averageViewPercentage).toFixed(1)}%` : '—', icon: Eye },
> 121	    { label: 'Inscritos líq.', value: `${gained >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gained}`, icon: Users },
> 122	    { label: 'Curtidas', value: formatNumber(metrics.likes), icon: ThumbsUp },
> 123	  ];
> 124	
> 125	  return (
> 126	    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
> 127	      {tiles.map((t) => (
> 128	        <Card key={t.label} className="bg-card/60">
> 129	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 130	            <t.icon className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />
> 131	            <span className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{t.value}</span>
> 132	            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.label}</span>
> 133	          </CardContent>
> 134	        </Card>
> 135	      ))}
> 136	    </div>
> 137	  );
> 138	}

> 140	// ── Revenue card (Fatia 2 — força o escopo yt-analytics-monetary.readonly) ──────
> 141	function RevenueCard() {
> 142	  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useYouTubeRevenue();
> 143	
> 144	  const money = useMemo(() => {
> 145	    if (!data || !data.monetized || !data.rows?.length) return null;
> 146	    const row = data.rows[0];
> 147	    const out: Record<string, number> = {};
> 148	    data.columnHeaders.forEach((c, i) => { out[c.name] = Number(row[i] ?? 0); });
> 149	    return out;
> 150	  }, [data]);
> 151	
> 152	  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full rounded-xl" />;
> 153	  if (isError) {
> 154	    return (
> 155	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 156	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 157	          Não foi possível carregar a receita: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 158	        </CardContent>
> 159	      </Card>
> 160	    );
> 161	  }
> 162	  // monetized:false is a valid state — the call still proved the monetary scope.
> 163	  if (!data?.monetized || !money) {
> 164	    return (
> 165	      <Card className="bg-card/60">
> 166	        <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 167	          <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
> 168	          Sem dados de receita no período — o canal não está monetizado (fora do YouTube Partner Program) ou
> 169	          não gerou receita nos últimos 28 dias.
> 170	        </CardContent>
> 171	      </Card>
> 172	    );
> 173	  }
> 174	
> 175	  const fmtUsd = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
> 176	  const tiles = [
> 177	    { label: 'Receita estimada', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedRevenue ?? 0) },
> 178	    { label: 'Receita de anúncios', value: fmtUsd(money.estimatedAdRevenue ?? 0) },
> 179	    { label: 'CPM', value: fmtUsd(money.cpm ?? 0) },
> 180	    { label: 'Reproduções monetizadas', value: formatNumber(money.monetizedPlaybacks ?? 0) },
> 181	  ];
> 182	  return (
> 183	    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
> 184	      {tiles.map((t) => (
> 185	        <Card key={t.label} className="bg-card/60">
> 186	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 187	            <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
> 188	            <span className="text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">{t.value}</span>
> 189	            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.label}</span>
> 190	          </CardContent>
> 191	        </Card>
> 192	      ))}
> 193	    </div>
> 194	  );
> 195	}

> 197	// ── Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 — força youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) ──────
> 198	function EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {
> 199	  const update = useUpdateVideo();
> 200	  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
> 201	  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
> 202	
> 203	  // Seed the fields when a video is opened (keyed remount via `key` on the caller keeps this simple).
> 204	  useMemo(() => {
> 205	    setTitle(video?.snippet?.title ?? '');
> 206	    setDescription(video?.snippet?.description ?? '');
> 207	  }, [video]);
> 208	
> 209	  if (!video) return null;
> 210	  const save = async () => {
> 211	    try {
> 212	      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });
> 213	      toast.success('Vídeo atualizado no YouTube.');
> 214	      onClose();
> 215	    } catch (e) {
> 216	      toast.error((e as Error).message);
> 217	    }
> 218	  };
> 219	  return (
> 220	    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
> 221	      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
> 222	        <DialogHeader>
> 223	          <DialogTitle>Editar vídeo</DialogTitle>
> 224	          <DialogDescription>Altera o título e a descrição direto no seu canal do YouTube (videos.update).</DialogDescription>
> 225	        </DialogHeader>
> 226	        <div className="space-y-3">
> 227	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 228	            <Label htmlFor="yt-title">Título</Label>
> 229	            <Input id="yt-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
> 230	          </div>
> 231	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 232	            <Label htmlFor="yt-desc">Descrição</Label>
> 233	            <Textarea id="yt-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />
> 234	          </div>
> 235	        </div>
> 236	        <DialogFooter>
> 237	          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>
> 238	          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className="gap-2">
> 239	            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
> 240	            Salvar no YouTube
> 241	          </Button>
> 242	        </DialogFooter>
> 243	      </DialogContent>
> 244	    </Dialog>
> 245	  );
> 246	}

> 254	function VideoRow({
> 255	  v, canWrite, onEdit, onDelete,
> 256	}: {
> 257	  v: YouTubeVideo;
> 258	  canWrite: boolean;
> 259	  onEdit: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;
> 260	  onDelete: (v: YouTubeVideo) => void;

> 262	  const thumb = v.snippet?.thumbnails?.default?.url ?? v.snippet?.thumbnails?.medium?.url;

> 264	    <TableRow>

> 271	          )}
> 272	          <div className="min-w-0">
> 273	            {/* O título navega para a página de análise do vídeo (interna), não para o YouTube. */}
> 274	            <Link
> 275	              to={`/dashboard/youtube/studio-yt/video/${v.id}`}

> 279	            </Link>
> 280	          </div>
> 281	        </div>
> 282	      </TableCell>
> 283	      <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatDate(v.snippet?.publishedAt)}</TableCell>
> 284	      <TableCell>
> 285	        <Badge variant="outline" className={privacyBadge(v.status?.privacyStatus)}>
> 286	          {v.status?.privacyStatus ?? '—'}
> 287	        </Badge>
> 288	      </TableCell>
> 289	      <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{v.status?.uploadStatus ?? '—'}</TableCell>
> 290	      <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums text-xs">{formatDuration(v.contentDetails?.duration)}</TableCell>
> 291	      <TableCell className="text-xs uppercase">{v.contentDetails?.definition ?? '—'}</TableCell>
> 292	      <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.viewCount)}</TableCell>
> 293	      <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.likeCount)}</TableCell>
> 294	      <TableCell className="tabular-nums">{formatNumber(v.statistics?.commentCount)}</TableCell>
> 295	      <TableCell className="tabular-nums text-xs">{v.snippet?.tags?.length ?? 0}</TableCell>
> 296	      <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.snippet?.categoryId ?? '—'}</TableCell>
> 297	      <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.madeForKids ? 'Sim' : 'Não'}</TableCell>
> 298	      <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.license ?? '—'}</TableCell>
> 299	      <TableCell className="text-xs">{v.status?.embeddable ? 'Sim' : 'Não'}</TableCell>

> 301	      <TableCell className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{v.id}</TableCell>
> 302	      {canWrite && (

> 313	            >

> 323	function VideosTable({ canWrite }: { canWrite: boolean }) {
> 324	  const { videos, isLoading, isError, error, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage, fetchNextPage, refetch, isRefetching } =
> 325	    useYouTubeVideos();
> 326	  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);
> 327	  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<YouTubeVideo | null>(null);
> 328	  const del = useDeleteVideo();
> 329	
> 330	  const confirmDelete = async () => {
> 331	    if (!deleting) return;
> 332	    try {
> 333	      await del.mutateAsync(deleting.id);
> 334	      toast.success('Vídeo excluído permanentemente do YouTube.');
> 335	      setDeleting(null);
> 336	    } catch (e) {
> 337	      toast.error((e as Error).message);
> 338	    }
> 339	  };
> 340	
> 341	  if (isLoading) {
> 342	    return (
> 343	      <div className="space-y-2">
> 344	        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
> 345	          <Skeleton key={i} className="h-14 w-full rounded" />
> 346	        ))}
> 347	      </div>
> 348	    );
> 349	  }
> 350	  if (isError) {
> 351	    return (
> 352	      <Card className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
> 353	        <CardContent className="py-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
> 354	          Não foi possível listar os vídeos: {(error as Error)?.message}
> 355	        </CardContent>
> 356	      </Card>
> 357	    );
> 358	  }
> 359	
> 360	  return (
> 361	    <Card>
> 362	      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2">
> 363	        <div>
> 364	          <CardTitle className="text-base">Vídeos do canal ({videos.length}{hasNextPage ? '+' : ''})</CardTitle>
> 365	          <CardDescription>
> 366	            {canWrite
> 367	              ? 'Tabela completa da API + ações de edição e exclusão dos seus próprios vídeos.'
> 368	              : 'Tabela completa de propriedades da API (somente leitura).'}
> 369	          </CardDescription>
> 370	        </div>
> 371	        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => refetch()} disabled={isRefetching}>
> 372	          <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isRefetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
> 373	          Atualizar
> 374	        </Button>
> 375	      </CardHeader>
> 376	      <CardContent>
> 377	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
> 378	          <Table>
> 379	            <TableHeader>
> 380	              <TableRow>
> 381	                {COLUMNS.map((c) => (
> 382	                  <TableHead key={c} className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{c}</TableHead>
> 383	                ))}
> 384	                {canWrite && <TableHead className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">Ações</TableHead>}
> 385	              </TableRow>
> 386	            </TableHeader>
> 387	            <TableBody>
> 388	              {videos.map((v) => (
> 389	                <VideoRow key={v.id} v={v} canWrite={canWrite} onEdit={setEditing} onDelete={setDeleting} />
> 390	              ))}
> 391	            </TableBody>
> 392	          </Table>
> 393	        </div>
> 394	        {hasNextPage && (
> 395	          <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center">
> 396	            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()} disabled={isFetchingNextPage}>
> 397	              {isFetchingNextPage ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : null}
> 398	              Carregar mais
> 399	            </Button>
> 400	          </div>
> 401	        )}
> 402	      </CardContent>
> 403	
> 404	      {/* Fatia 2 — edit (keyed remount seeds the fields) + destructive delete confirmation. */}
> 405	      <EditVideoDialog key={editing?.id ?? 'none'} video={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />
> 406	      <AlertDialog open={!!deleting} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleting(null)}>
> 407	        <AlertDialogContent>
> 408	          <AlertDialogHeader>
> 409	            <AlertDialogTitle>Excluir vídeo permanentemente?</AlertDialogTitle>
> 410	            <AlertDialogDescription>
> 411	              "{deleting?.snippet?.title ?? deleting?.id}" será removido do seu canal do YouTube de forma
> 412	              PERMANENTE e irreversível (videos.delete). Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.
> 413	            </AlertDialogDescription>
> 414	          </AlertDialogHeader>
> 415	          <AlertDialogFooter>
> 416	            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={del.isPending}>Cancelar</AlertDialogCancel>
> 417	            <AlertDialogAction
> 418	              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); confirmDelete(); }}
> 419	              disabled={del.isPending}
> 420	              className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
> 421	            >
> 422	              {del.isPending ? <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />}
> 423	              Excluir permanentemente
> 424	            </AlertDialogAction>
> 425	          </AlertDialogFooter>
> 426	        </AlertDialogContent>
> 427	      </AlertDialog>
> 428	    </Card>
> 429	  );
> 430	}

> 432	// ── Page ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 433	export default function YouTubeStudioPage() {
> 434	  const conn = useYouTubeConnection();
> 435	  const { channel } = useYouTubeChannel();
> 436	  const [pubOpen, setPubOpen] = useState(false);
> 437	  const [pubTab, setPubTab] = useState<'video' | 'shorts' | 'historico'>('video');
> 438	
> 439	  const header = (
> 440	    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
> 441	      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
> 442	        <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-red-600/15 text-red-400">
> 443	          <MonitorPlay className="h-6 w-6" />
> 444	        </div>
> 445	        <div>
> 446	          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">YouTube Studio</h1>
> 447	          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 448	            {conn.channelTitle ? `Canal conectado: ${conn.channelTitle}` : 'Gestão do canal conectado ao MCORCH'}
> 449	          </p>
> 450	        </div>
> 451	      </div>
> 452	      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
> 453	        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => { setPubTab('video'); setPubOpen(true); }}>
> 454	          Publicar
> 455	        </Button>
> 456	        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => { setPubTab('historico'); setPubOpen(true); }}>
> 457	          Histórico
> 458	        </Button>
> 459	        {channel?.snippet?.customUrl && (
> 460	          <a
> 461	            href={`https://youtube.com/${channel.snippet.customUrl}`}
> 462	            target="_blank"
> 463	            rel="noreferrer"
> 464	            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-cyan-300 hover:underline"
> 465	          >
> 466	            {channel.snippet.customUrl} <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
> 467	          </a>
> 468	        )}
> 469	      </div>
> 470	    </div>
> 471	  );
> 472	
> 473	  if (conn.isLoading) {
> 474	    return (
> 475	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 476	        {header}
> 477	        <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full rounded-xl" />
> 478	      </div>
> 479	    );
> 480	  }
> 481	
> 482	  // Not connected → connect CTA
> 483	  if (!conn.isConnected) {
> 484	    return (
> 485	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 486	        {header}
> 487	        <Card className="border-cyan-500/20">
> 488	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-12 text-center">
> 489	            <Link2 className="h-10 w-10 text-cyan-400" />
> 490	            <div>
> 491	              <p className="font-medium">Nenhum canal do YouTube conectado</p>
> 492	              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
> 493	                Conecte o canal para ler vídeos e métricas diretamente no MCORCH.
> 494	              </p>
> 495	            </div>
> 496	            <Button onClick={conn.connect} className="gap-2">
> 497	              <MonitorPlay className="h-4 w-4" /> Conectar YouTube
> 498	            </Button>
> 499	          </CardContent>
> 500	        </Card>
> 501	      </div>
> 502	    );
> 503	  }
> 504	
> 505	  // Connected but missing read/analytics scopes → reconnect CTA (fail-closed, no API call fired)
> 506	  if (conn.needsReconnect) {
> 507	    return (
> 508	      <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 509	        {header}
> 510	        <Card className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5">
> 511	          <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4 py-8">
> 512	            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
> 513	              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 flex-shrink-0 text-amber-400" />
> 514	              <div className="space-y-1">
> 515	                <p className="font-medium text-amber-200">Permissões insuficientes para ler o canal</p>
> 516	                <p className="text-sm text-amber-200/80">
> 517	                  A conexão atual só permite publicar. Para listar os vídeos do canal, reconecte
> 518	                  concedendo a permissão de leitura do YouTube.
> 519	                </p>
> 520	              </div>
> 521	            </div>
> 522	            <div>
> 523	              <Button onClick={conn.reconnect} className="gap-2">
> 524	                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" /> Reconectar com permissões ampliadas
> 525	              </Button>
> 526	            </div>
> 527	          </CardContent>
> 528	        </Card>
> 529	      </div>
> 530	    );
> 531	  }
> 532	
> 533	  // Fully connected + scoped → channel summary + metrics + videos table
> 534	  const stats = channel?.statistics;
> 535	  return (
> 536	    <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
> 537	      {header}
> 538	
> 539	      {stats && (

> 541	          <Card className="bg-card/60">

> 543	              <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />
> 544	              <span className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{formatNumber(stats.subscriberCount)}</span>
> 545	              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Inscritos</span>
> 546	            </CardContent>
> 547	          </Card>
> 548	          <Card className="bg-card/60">
> 549	            <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 550	              <Eye className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />
> 551	              <span className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{formatNumber(stats.viewCount)}</span>
> 552	              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Views totais</span>

> 556	            <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-4">
> 557	              <MonitorPlay className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />

```
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger />
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle />
      <AlertDialogDescription />
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel />
      <AlertDialogAction />
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

In the current code:
- `AlertDialogHeader` is a direct child of `AlertDialog`
- `AlertDialogContent` is a direct child of `AlertDialog` (but only contains `AlertDialogDescription`)
- `AlertDialogFooter` is a direct child of `AlertDialog` (but it should be inside `AlertDialogContent`)

The fix is to move `AlertDialogFooter` inside `AlertDialogContent`, and also move `AlertDialogHeader` inside `AlertDialogContent`.

Let me fix this.

> 367	            {canWrite
> 368	              ? 'Tabela completa da API + ações de edição e exclusão dos seus próprios vídeos.'

> 373	          <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isRefetching ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
> 374	          Atualizar
> 375	        </Button>
> 376	      </CardHeader>
> 377	      <CardContent>
> 378	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
> 379	          <Table>
> 380	            <TableHeader>

> 382	                {COLUMNS.map((c) => (
> 383	                  <TableHead key={c} className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">{c}</TableHead>
> 384	                ))}
> 385	                {canWrite && <TableHead className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">Ações</TableHead>}

> 34	  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
> 35	  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;

> 42	  if (!m) return '—';
> 43	  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);

> 46	  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');

Now I understand the full picture. The `youtube-data` edge function's `list_videos` action currently:
1. Gets the uploads playlist

3. Then fetches video details for those IDs

The YouTube Data API v3 doesn't directly support filtering/sorting on the `playlistItems` endpoint. The filtering/sorting would need to happen after fetching all video data. However, we can add parameters to the edge function to support:
- Filtering by privacy status
- Filtering by search term (title)
- Sorting by viewCount, publishedAt, etc.

But since the YouTube API doesn't support server-side filtering/sorting on playlistItems, we'd need to:
1. Fetch all pages (or a larger batch)
2. Filter/sort in the edge function
3. Return paginated results

Actually, the better approach would be to use the `search.list` endpoint with `forMine=true` which supports:
- `order` parameter (date, rating, relevance, title, viewCount, videoCount)
- `type=video`

> 197	// ── Edit video dialog (Fatia 2 — força youtube.force-ssl via videos.update) ──────
> 198	function EditVideoDialog({ video, onClose }: { video: YouTubeVideo | null; onClose: () => void }) {
> 199	  const update = useUpdateVideo();
> 200	  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
> 201	  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');

> 208	
> 209	  if (!video) return null;
> 210	  const save = async () => {
> 211	    try {
> 212	      await update.mutateAsync({ videoId: video.id, title: title.trim(), description });
> 213	      toast.success('Vídeo atualizado no YouTube.');
> 214	      onClose();
> 215	    } catch (e) {
> 216	      toast.error((e as Error).message);
> 217	    }
> 218	  };
> 219	  return (
> 220	    <Dialog open={!!video} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
> 221	      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
> 222	        <DialogHeader>
> 223	          <DialogTitle>Editar vídeo</DialogTitle>

> 227	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 228	            <Label htmlFor="yt-title">Título</Label>
> 229	            <Input id="yt-title" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
> 230	          </div>
> 231	          <div className="space-y-1">
> 232	            <Label htmlFor="yt-desc">Descrição</Label>
> 233	            <Textarea id="yt-desc" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} rows={5} maxLength={5000} />
> 234	          </div>
> 235	        </div>
> 236	        <DialogFooter>
> 237	          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={update.isPending}>Cancelar</Button>
> 238	          <Button onClick={save} disabled={update.isPending || !title.trim()} className="gap-2">
> 239	            {update.isPending ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
> 240	            Salvar no YouTube
> 241	          </Button>
> 242	        </DialogFooter>

## Summary: YouTube Studio Table Refactor

### Created new shared component: `src/components/youtube/YouTubeVideosTable.tsx`

**Features:**
- **Robust semantic HTML** — proper `<thead>/<th scope="col">`, `<tbody>/<td>` structure
- **Server-side filter/sort** — wired to `useYouTubeVideos({ filter, sort, maxResults })` which hits the `youtube-data` edge function `list_videos` action with filter/sort/maxResults params
- **Toolbar with:**
  - Search input (title search)
  - Privacy status dropdown (All / Público / Não listado / Privado)
  - Sort dropdown (all sortable columns, both directions)
  - Refresh button + live total count
- **Horizontal scroll** with per-column `min-width` — 17 columns never squished
- **Clickable sortable headers** with direction indicators (▲/▼)
- **404-safe delete** — catches `videoNotFound`/`not_found` and shows friendly toast: *"Vídeo já não existe no YouTube — removendo da lista local."*
- **Edit + Delete actions** when `hasWriteScope` (youtube.force-ssl)

### Refactored files:

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/components/youtube/YouTubeVideosTable.tsx` | **New** — single source of truth for the video table |
| `src/components/youtube/ChannelVideosCard.tsx` | Simplified to `<YouTubeVideosTable showActions />` |
| `src/pages/YouTubeStudioPage.tsx` | Removed ~350 lines of duplicated `VideosTable`/`VideoRow`/`EditVideoDialog`/`COLUMNS` — now uses `ChannelVideosCard` |

### Edge function updated:
- `supabase/functions/youtube-data/index.ts` — `list_videos` action now accepts `filter`, `sort`, `maxResults` params and applies them server-side (privacyStatus filter, search on title, sorting by publishedAt/viewCount/likeCount/etc., pagination limit)

### Build verification:
- ✅ `bun run build` — no errors, all chunks generated
- ✅ Synced to `/home/gcrUX/htdocs/constellation-orchestra/dist/` (nginx serves from here)

Run these checks and report findings. **Block the seal if any CRITICAL finding exists.**

> ⚠️ **SCOPE NOTE:** This phase scans changes that exist NOW (before Phase 5 writes HANDOFF.md).
> A second mandatory scan runs in Phase 5b, after HANDOFF.md is written and before it is committed.

```bash
# 1a. Secret leak scan — check staged + working tree for hardcoded credentials
git diff HEAD | grep -E "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{20,}|STRIPE_|SECRET_KEY|ACCESS_TOKEN|api_key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{10,})" \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_" | head -20

# 1b. Edge function JWT enforcement — every user-facing function must verify JWT
grep -rL "Authorization\|jwt\|JWT\|service_role" supabase/functions/*/index.ts \
  | grep -v "get-infra-status\|watchdog" || echo "ALL FUNCTIONS: JWT enforced ✅"

# 1c. Client-side coin deduction guard — must NEVER update mco_balance directly from client
grep -rn "mco_balance.*update\|UPDATE.*mco_balance" src/ \
  | grep -v "settings\|top.up\|topup\|SettingsPage" | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1d. RLS bypass risk — check for supabase.rpc calls without auth context
grep -rn "service_role\|bypass.*rls\|rls.*bypass" src/ | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1e. Sensitive data in console.log
grep -rn "console\.log.*token\|console\.log.*key\|console\.log.*secret\|console\.log.*password" src/ \
  | head -10 || echo "NO SENSITIVE LOGS ✅"
```

**Security verdict:** list each check as ✅ PASS / ⚠️ WARN / 🔴 BLOCK.

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault

- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 5 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)

> 36	function formatNumber(v?: string | number): string {
> 37	  const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
> 38	  if (n === undefined || n === null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
> 39	  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
> 40	  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
> 41	  return String(n);
> 42	}

> 44	function formatDuration(iso?: string): string {
> 45	  if (!iso) return '—';
> 46	  const m = iso.match(/PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?/);
> 47	  if (!m) return '—';
> 48	  const h = Number(m[1] ?? 0);
> 49	  const min = Number(m[2] ?? 0);
> 50	  const s = Number(m[3] ?? 0);
> 51	  const pad = (x: number) => String(x).padStart(2, '0');
> 52	  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${pad(min)}:${pad(s)}` : `${min}:${pad(s)}`;
> 53	}
> 54	
> 55	function formatDate(iso?: string): string {
> 56	  if (!iso) return '—';

> 14	import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

> 25	const SCOPE_ANALYTICS = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/yt-analytics.readonly";
> 26	const SCOPE_ANALYTICS_MONETARY = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/yt-analytics-monetary.readonly";

> 29	// deno-lint-ignore no-explicit-any

> 32	const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) =>
> 33	  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
> 34	    status,
> 35	    headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 36	  });

> 38	function isoDate(daysAgo: number): string {
> 39	  return new Date(Date.now() - daysAgo * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
> 40	}
> 41	
> 42	// Parse an ISO-8601 video duration (PT#H#M#S) → seconds. null when unparseable (PIPC S2 clock conversion).
> 43	function parseIsoDuration(iso: string | undefined): number | null {
> 44	  if (!iso) return null;
> 45	  const m = /^PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?$/.exec(iso);
> 46	  if (!m) return null;
> 47	  return Number(m[1] ?? 0) * 3600 + Number(m[2] ?? 0) * 60 + Number(m[3] ?? 0);
> 48	}
> 49	function fmtClock(secs: number): string {
> 50	  const mm = Math.floor(secs / 60);
> 51	  return `${mm}:${String(secs % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
> 52	}

> 54	// Resolve a usable access token: refresh via refresh-social-token (audited rotation) when the stored
> 55	// token is near expiry, then re-read the decrypted value. Never touches the raw refresh_token here.
> 56	async function ensureFreshToken(
> 57	  admin: Any,
> 58	  account: Any,
> 59	  supabaseUrl: string,
> 60	  serviceKey: string,
> 61	): Promise<string | null> {
> 62	  const expMs = account.token_expires_at ? new Date(account.token_expires_at).getTime() : 0;
> 63	  const stale = !account.access_token || expMs - Date.now() < 60_000;
> 64	  if (stale && account.refresh_token) {
> 65	    try {
> 66	      await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/refresh-social-token`, {
> 67	        method: "POST",
> 68	        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 69	        body: JSON.stringify({ social_account_id: account.id }),
> 70	      });
> 71	      const { data: fresh } = await admin
> 72	        .from("decrypted_social_accounts")
> 73	        .select("access_token")
> 74	        .eq("id", account.id)
> 75	        .maybeSingle();
> 76	      return fresh?.access_token ?? account.access_token ?? null;
> 77	    } catch (_e) {
> 78	      return account.access_token ?? null;
> 79	    }
> 80	  }
> 81	  return account.access_token ?? null;
> 82	}

> 84	function googleError(r: { status: number; data: Any }, pulse: (s: "degraded") => void): Response {
> 85	  const reason = r.data?.error?.errors?.[0]?.reason ?? r.data?.error?.status ?? "google_api_error";
> 86	  pulse("degraded");
> 87	  const quota = r.status === 403 && String(reason).toLowerCase().includes("quota");
> 88	  return json(
> 89	    {
> 90	      error: quota ? "youtube_quota_exceeded" : "youtube_api_error",
> 91	      status: r.status,
> 92	      reason,
> 93	      message: r.data?.error?.message ?? undefined,
> 94	      action: quota
> 95	        ? "Cota diária da API do YouTube excedida — tente novamente após a meia-noite (Pacific Time)."
> 96	        : undefined,
> 97	    },
> 98	    r.status === 403 ? 403 : 502,
> 99	  );
> 100	}

> 102	Deno.serve(async (req) => {

> 107	  const serviceKey = (Deno.env.get("SB_SECRET_KEY") ?? Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"))!;

> 112	  const pulse = (status: "healthy" | "degraded") =>
> 113	    admin.from("infra_health_logs").insert({ service: "youtube-studio", status }).then(() => {}, () => {});
> 114	
> 115	  try {

> 121	    });
> 122	    const { data: { user }, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser();

> 129	    // Owner-scoped account resolution + server-side token decryption. The explicit user_id filter is the

> 132	      .from("decrypted_social_accounts")

> 134	      .eq("user_id", user.id)
> 135	      .eq("platform", "youtube")
> 136	      .eq("is_active", true)

> 139	      pulse("degraded");

> 141	    }

> 144	        { error: "youtube_not_connected", action: "Conecte seu canal do YouTube em /dashboard/social" },
> 145	        409,

> 147	    }

> 149	    // Fail-closed scope gate (G2): read actions need youtube.readonly; metrics need yt-analytics.readonly.

> 160	    }
> 161	    if (action === "revenue_metrics" && !scopes.includes(SCOPE_ANALYTICS_MONETARY)) {

> 167	    if (missing.length) {

> 178	    const token = await ensureFreshToken(admin, account, supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

> 184	    const gfetch = async (url: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: number; data: Any }> => {

> 190	    // Write helper (PUT/DELETE/POST). DELETE returns 204 no-body → tolerate empty JSON.
> 191	    const gsend = async (

> 194	      payload?: Any,

> 201	        },

> 204	      const text = await res.text();

> 206	      try { data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; } catch { data = { raw: text }; }

> 210	    if (action === "channel_summary") {

> 357	    // ── PIPC S1 / FR-PIPC-011 — audience RETENTION curve of one video (the GAP-mãe signal) ──

> 398	    // ── PIPC S2 / FR-PIPC-014/015 — per-episode retention ANALYSIS (the EP05-direction brief) ──
> 399	    // Reads the persisted curve (episode_retention_curve, owner-scoped) → drop points (<50%,<25%) + steepest
> 400	    // single-step dip → clock timestamp (best-effort duration) → actionable PT-BR brief in episode_insights.
> 401	    if (action === "episode_retention_analysis") {
> 402	      const videoId = typeof body.videoId === "string" ? body.videoId.trim() : "";
> 403	      if (!videoId) return json({ error: "videoId_required", action: "Informe o videoId." }, 422);
> 404	      const { data: curve, error: cErr } = await admin
> 405	        .from("episode_retention_curve")

> 411	      if (!curve || curve.length === 0) {

> 413	      }
> 414	      const wr = (p: Any) => Number(p.audience_watch_ratio);
> 415	      const below = (thr: number): number | null => {
> 416	        const hit = curve.find((p: Any) => wr(p) < thr);
> 417	        return hit ? Number(hit.percent_bucket) : null;
> 418	      };
> 419	      const drop50 = below(0.5), drop25 = below(0.25);
> 420	      let steepest: number | null = null, steepestLoss = 0;
> 421	      for (let i = 1; i < curve.length; i++) {
> 422	        const loss = wr(curve[i - 1]) - wr(curve[i]);
> 423	        if (loss > steepestLoss) { steepestLoss = loss; steepest = Number(curve[i].percent_bucket); }
> 424	      }
> 425	      let durationSeconds: number | null = null;

> 427	        const vd = await gfetch(`${YT_DATA}/videos?part=contentDetails&id=${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}`);

> 433	        return durationSeconds ? `${p}% (${fmtClock(Math.round(Number(pct) * durationSeconds))})` : `${p}%`;
> 434	      };
> 435	      const minWr = Math.min(...curve.map(wr));

> 437	      const summary = drop50 == null

> 441	        points: curve.length,
> 442	        min_watch_ratio: Math.round(minWr * 1000) / 1000,
> 443	        avg_relative_performance: Math.round(avgRel * 1000) / 1000,
> 444	        steepest_loss: Math.round(steepestLoss * 1000) / 1000,

> 461	    // ── Fatia 2 — monetary reports (force: yt-analytics-monetary.readonly) ──

> 469	      const params = new URLSearchParams({ ids: "channel==MINE", startDate, endDate, metrics, currency: "USD" });
> 470	      const r = await gfetch(`${YT_ANALYTICS}/reports?${params.toString()}`);
> 471	      if (!r.ok) {
> 472	        // A non-partner / non-monetized channel returns 403 for monetary metrics. That is NOT an app failure —
> 473	        // the CALL itself demonstrates the scope. Return a clean, monetized:false state (never a crash).
> 474	        if (r.status === 403) {
> 475	          pulse("healthy");

> 486	    if (action === "update_video") {
> 487	      const videoId = typeof body.videoId === "string" ? body.videoId : "";
> 488	      if (!videoId) return json({ error: "videoId required" }, 400);
> 489	      // videos.update REPLACES the sent part; snippet.categoryId is REQUIRED. Read the current snippet first,
> 490	      // merge only the changed fields, then PUT. Owner-scope is enforced by the user's own token (Google 403s
> 491	      // a foreign video → googleError surfaces it cleanly).
> 492	      const cur = await gfetch(`${YT_DATA}/videos?part=snippet&id=${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}`);
> 493	      if (!cur.ok) return googleError(cur, pulse);

> 495	      if (!item) return json({ error: "video_not_found" }, 404);

> 499	        description: typeof body.description === "string" ? body.description : snip.description,
> 500	        categoryId: snip.categoryId, // required by the API — preserve the existing category
> 501	      };
> 502	      if (Array.isArray(body.tags)) newSnippet.tags = body.tags.filter((t: Any) => typeof t === "string");
> 503	      else if (Array.isArray(snip.tags)) newSnippet.tags = snip.tags;
> 504	      if (snip.defaultLanguage) newSnippet.defaultLanguage = snip.defaultLanguage;

> 508	      return json({ updated: true, video: r.data });

> 514	      if (!videoId) return json({ error: "videoId required" }, 400);
> 515	      const r = await gsend(`${YT_DATA}/videos?id=${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}`, "DELETE");
> 516	      // 204 = deleted (no body). Anything else that is not ok is a real error.
> 517	      if (!r.ok && r.status !== 204) return googleError(r, pulse);
> 518	      // Distinguishable telemetry: a permanent delete must never look like a plain
> 519	      // list in the HUD. The event carries NO per-tenant payload (infra_health_logs
> 520	      // is global-read); the audit trail with the videoId lives in the mesh (RLS-scoped).
> 521	      admin.from("infra_health_logs").insert({

> 529	        metadata: { kind: "youtube_delete", video_id: videoId },
> 530	      }).then(() => {}, () => {});
> 531	      return json({ deleted: true, videoId });
> 532	    }
> 533	
> 534	    return json({ error: "unknown_action" }, 400);
> 535	  } catch (err) {
> 536	    console.error("youtube-data error:", err);
> 537	    pulse("degraded");
> 538	    return json({ error: "youtube_data_failed" }, 500);
> 539	  }
> 540	});
